criteria.rationale: The feature is explicitly optional and scoped to the Personal Assistant Gateway, while Coding CLI behavior is expressly unchanged; no product-specific kernel default is introduced.
Omission preserves the triggering run model and an unregistered selection fails startup, but the required failure behavior for an explicitly empty value is unspecified.
It limits the override to automatic permission classification and preserves normal and post-tool run models, but does not explicitly require the selected model for both classifier stages.

Existing permission results and unattended fallback semantics are declared unchanged, but classifier-call failure, prohibition of model switching, and preservation of same-model retries are not specified.
Configuration is described as taking effect after Gateway restart, but the running Gateway retaining its bound choice until another restart and the absence of hot reload are not explicit.
The PA/Gateway, model-catalog, and CLI boundaries are preserved without prescribing a kernel topology, but the Author is not explicitly required to verify repository facts.
The selection is optional and PA-scoped, Coding CLI remains unchanged, and any shared-kernel capability is framed as a product-neutral explicit override.
Omission and unregistered-model behavior are correct, but treating YAML null and blank strings as omission directly contradicts the requirement that an explicit empty value fail startup visibly.
Only automatic permission classification receives the selected model and normal or post-tool turns retain the run model, but the two classifier stages are not individually or explicitly covered.
Runtime failure preserves existing safe permission fallback and explicitly forbids switching to the run model, but preservation of existing same-model retry behavior is omitted.

The text centers validation and activation on startup or restart and rejects hot updating the local model directory, but it does not explicitly bind the selected choice for the Gateway process lifetime.

The projection uses recognizable repository boundaries and keeps the kernel capability generic, but it does not instruct the Author to ground facts, and its shared-kernel placement edges into design-topology prescription.

summary: Both projections cover the central optional PA-specific model override and protect normal run-model behavior, but each leaves critical details incomplete. P1 omits explicit-empty validation and classifier-failure model/retry semantics. P2 contradicts explicit-empty startup failure by accepting null or blank values and omits explicit same-model retry preservation.
